item.title: County passes 2026 budget, Exeter-area roundabout returns to agenda
item.description: GODERICH – Councillors passed Huron County’s 2026 budget at their March 18 meeting, but a much-discussed roundabout project that had been removed from the budget dominated the meeting’s debate.
